meaning: AFP T2 (metis A1b A4 G_def ess_def). Let x be God-like and have Ψ. By excluded middle Ψ is positive or not. If not, its negation is positive (A1b) and x, having every positive property, lacks Ψ: contradiction. If so, Ψ is necessarily positive (A4), so at every accessible world every God-like being has Ψ.
